newsitem.title: UK: UK shares recover on strong U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: UK shares recover on strong U.S. rally.

text.p: UK shares, still at the mercy of a volatile Wall Street, bounced back on Friday to recover just over half of Thursday's losses after a recovery in the U.S. market.
The FTSE 100 index closed 32.1 points higher at 4,089.5, but trade remained relatively thin as many players kept well clear of the market. Gainers outweighed losers by about five times.
The Mid-250 index added 24.2 points to 4,493.6.
